meta.name: ugc-repurposer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "repurpose influencer content", "turn one video into multiple ads", or "build a UGC asset library"; produces a content inventory with rights, a multi-channel repurposing map (1 video to 10+ assets), per-format transformation specs, and a 30-day distribution plan. Not for paid amplification spend planning — use content-amplifier.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将网红内容高效复用为多渠道广告素材。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one influencer video into 10+ ad assets with a distribution plan
